a11y.secondary.serius: Second activity, {0}. Press to make it primary
a11y.secondary.kocak: Second activity, {0}. Press to make it primary

alert.batteryLow.subtitle.kocak: {0}%. Plug it in, it deserves better.

settings.intro.serius: A small capsule above your screen for music, timers, meetings, and notifications. Everything is processed locally.
settings.intro.kocak: A tiny capsule up top for music, timers, meetings, and notifs. All processed on your machine, sent nowhere.

settings.humorNote.serius: Important text stays serious; screen readers always get the serious version.
settings.humorNote.kocak: The serious stuff stays serious. Screen readers are not in on the joke.

settings.autostartNote.serius: One entry under HKCU Run; turn it off here any time.
settings.autostartNote.kocak: One line under HKCU Run. Easy to revoke.

settings.autostartFailed.serius: Windows refused to write the startup entry. Try again, or add it yourself in Windows Settings.
settings.autostartFailed.kocak: Windows said no to the startup entry. Try once more, or add it yourself in Windows Settings.

settings.permissions.serius: What it uses: microphone status (registry), microphone mute (Core Audio), Windows notifications (separate permission), and a local settings file. No network, analytics, or recording.
settings.permissions.kocak: What it uses: mic status, mute button, notifications (if allowed), and a settings file. No network, analytics, or recording.

meeting.subtitle.kocak: Mic is on · {0}. Mind what you say about the boss.

notifications.denied.serius: Notification access denied: {0}. Turn it on in Settings → Privacy → Notifications.
notifications.denied.kocak: Notification access denied: {0}. Turn it on in Settings → Privacy → Notifications.

notifications.unavailable.serius: Windows notifications need an MSIX package; this build is not packaged yet, so notifications cannot be read.
notifications.unavailable.kocak: Windows notifications need an MSIX package. This build is not packaged, so no peeking at notifs yet.

notification.hidden.kocak: New message. Hidden because your screen is being shared.

habit.drink.title.kocak: Drink up, you are not a cactus

habit.drink.subtitle.serius: A glass of water, then carry on.
habit.drink.subtitle.kocak: One glass of water. Plants need it, so do you.

habit.eye.subtitle.serius: Look at something far away for 20 seconds.
habit.eye.subtitle.kocak: Look far away for 20 seconds. Stop scrolling.

habit.screen.title.kocak: You have been staring at the screen too long

habit.screen.subtitle.serius: Stand up and stretch for a moment.
habit.screen.subtitle.kocak: Stand up and stretch. The chair will wait.

settings.contextNote.serius: The capsule adapts during games, fullscreen video, meetings, presentations, and screen sharing. Nothing is injected into other apps.
settings.contextNote.kocak: The capsule knows when to back off: games, video, meetings, sharing. It never injects into other apps.

settings.safeShare.serius: Hide notification contents while screen sharing

settings.safeShareNote.serius: While sharing or recording, only “You have a new message” is shown.
settings.safeShareNote.kocak: While sharing, all you get is “You have a new message”.

settings.prayerNote.serius: No internet; uses Jakarta coordinates unless configured otherwise.
settings.prayerNote.kocak: No internet. Jakarta coordinates, unless you change them.

settings.habitsNote.serius: Water, eye rest, and screen time. Can be turned off at any time.
settings.habitsNote.kocak: Water, eye rest, and screen time. Off whenever you like.

settings.weatherNote.serius: Off by default. When enabled, the app asks for confirmation and uses the ADM4 code from the settings file.
settings.weatherNote.kocak: Off by default. Turn it on and the app asks first, then uses your ADM4 code.

settings.weatherUnavailable.serius: No BMKG ADM4 code yet. Add “WeatherAdm4” to settings.json to use this feature.
settings.weatherUnavailable.kocak: No BMKG ADM4 code yet. Add “WeatherAdm4” to settings.json first.

palette.placeholder.serius: Type a command, calculation, or app name
palette.placeholder.kocak: Type a command, sum, or app

palette.hint.serius: Ctrl+Alt+V to open · Esc to close · Enter to run
palette.hint.kocak: Ctrl+Alt+V opens · Esc closes · Enter runs

clipboard.ocrFailed.serius: OCR is not available on this device

camera.active.serius: Camera on · turns off when the island collapses
camera.active.kocak: Camera on · off when the capsule collapses

camera.denied.serius: Camera could not start: {0}. Enable camera access in Windows Settings.
camera.denied.kocak: Camera refused: {0}. Turn on camera access in Windows Settings.

settings.clipboardNote.serius: Memory only, at most 30 entries and 24 hours. Passwords, tokens, and card numbers are redacted before storage.
settings.clipboardNote.kocak: Memory only, 30 entries and 24 hours max. Passwords, tokens, and cards are redacted first.

settings.osdNote.serius: Shows the capsule when volume/brightness changes. The Windows OSD remains; this module can be turned off.
settings.osdNote.kocak: Capsule shows when volume/brightness changes. Windows OSD stays; this can be turned off.

settings.mirrorNote.serius: A short preview to check your appearance. The camera stops when the preview closes or the island collapses; nothing is saved.
settings.mirrorNote.kocak: Short preview to check your look. Camera stops when closed or the capsule collapses; nothing saved.

settings.shortcutsNote.serius: Only paths you register yourself, stored in shortcuts.json. Nothing is executed from outside sources.
settings.shortcutsNote.kocak: Only paths you add yourself in shortcuts.json. Nothing from outside runs.

settings.modulesNote.serius: Every Stage 5 module has its own switch and does not slow the others down.
settings.modulesNote.kocak: Every module has its own switch and does not slow the rest.
